reproducible.description: True only if you wrote at least one test that fails because of the reported bug.

reason.description: If reproducible: one or two sentences on what the failing test demonstrates. If not: why the bug could not be reproduced and what information a person would need.

test_files.description: Repository-relative paths (forward slashes) of the test files you created or changed.

test_cases.description: One entry per behaviour a tester should verify for this bug, written for a manual tester.

steps.description: Ordered manual steps in the running service.

expected.description: Expected result after the last step.

automated_test.description: Name of the automated test that covers this case, or an empty string.
